01About Shublah

One partner from first block to final handover.

Shublah Global Ventures Limited is a Nigerian private limited company (RC 9462811), registered with the Corporate Affairs Commission under CAMA 2020 and headquartered in Abuja, with a branch office in Jos, Plateau State. We source the materials, engineer the solution, build the structure and maintain it afterwards, and we develop smart residential estates, farm estates and mixed-use developments.

On site · POP ceiling works

Our Mission

To deliver dependable construction, supply and development services that build trust with every client and add lasting value to communities across Nigeria.

We do this by owning the whole job: we source the materials, engineer the solution, build it and maintain it, all to one standard.
